assertions.assertion: Program.cs registers CustomClaimsPrincipalFactory as IUserClaimsPrincipalFactory<ApplicationUser> BEFORE calling AddAspNetIdentity
Program.cs calls AddAspNetIdentity<ApplicationUser>() which will wrap and call through to the custom factory
assertions.rationale: AddAspNetIdentity<ApplicationUser>() called and explained as wrapping the factory.

assertions.assertion: A CustomProfileService class inherits from ProfileService<ApplicationUser> and overrides IsUserActiveAsync
The IsUserActiveAsync override checks a property on the user (e.g., user.IsEnabled or user.IsActive) to determine if the user is active
The CustomProfileService is registered in DI as the IProfileService implementation
